nodes.label: System-Boundary-Only Mocking
nodes.rationale: Mocking internal collaborators couples tests to implementation; only external boundaries (APIs, DB, time, FS) justify mocks.

nodes.label: Dependency Injection for Mockability
nodes.rationale: Passing external dependencies in rather than constructing them internally makes system boundaries mockable.

nodes.label: SDK-Style Interfaces Over Generic Fetchers
nodes.rationale: One function per external operation keeps mocks conditional-free and makes exercised endpoints visible per test.
